verses.original: Καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι εἰσίν τινες τῶν ἑστηκότων ὧδε οἵτινες οὐ μὴ γεύσωνται θανάτου ἕως ἂν ἴδωσιν τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐληλυθυῖαν ἐν δυνάμει
verses.transliteration: Kai elegen autois Amēn legō hymin hoti eisin tines tōn hestēkotōn hōde hoitines ou mē geusōntai thanatou heōs an idōsin tēn basileian tou Theou elēlythuian en dynamei
verses.literal: Then [Jesus] said to them Truly I tell you - there are some - standing here who vvv vvv will not taste death before . . . they see the kingdom - of God arrive with power

verses.original: Καὶ μετὰ ἓξ ἡμέρας ὁ Ἰησοῦς παραλαμβάνει τὸν Πέτρον καὶ τὸν Ἰάκωβον καὶ τὸν Ἰωάννην καὶ ἀναφέρει αὐτοὺς εἰς ὑψηλὸν ὄρος κατ’ ἰδίαν μόνους καὶ μετεμορφώθη ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai meta hex hēmeras ho Iēsous paralambanei ton Petron kai ton Iakōbon kai ton Iōannēn kai anapherei autous eis hypsēlon oros kat’ idian monous kai metemorphōthē emprosthen autōn
verses.literal: - After six days - Jesus took with [Him] - Peter - - James and - John and led them up . . . . . . a high mountain vvv [by] themselves . . . [There] He was transfigured before them

verses.original: καὶ αὐτοῦ τὰ ἱμάτια ἐγένετο λίαν στίλβοντα λευκὰ οἷα οὐ γναφεὺς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς δύναται οὕτως λευκᾶναι
verses.transliteration: kai autou ta himatia egeneto lian stilbonta leuka hoia ou gnapheus epi tēs gēs dynatai houtōs leukanai
verses.literal: - His - clothes became radiantly . . . white [brighter than] [any] launderer on - earth could - bleach them

verses.original: καὶ Ἠλίας σὺν Μωϋσεῖ ὤφθη αὐτοῖς καὶ ἦσαν συλλαλοῦντες τῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai Ēlias syn Mōusei ōphthē autois kai ēsan syllalountes tō Iēsou
verses.literal: And Elijah [and] Moses appeared before them - - talking with - Jesus

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ Πέτρος ἀποκριθεὶς λέγει τῷ Ἰησοῦ Ῥαββί ἐστιν καλόν ἡμᾶς εἶναι ὧδε καὶ ποιήσωμεν τρεῖς σκηνάς μίαν σοὶ καὶ μίαν Μωϋσεῖ καὶ μίαν Ἠλίᾳ
verses.transliteration: Kai ho Petros apokritheis legei tō Iēsou Rhabbi estin kalon hēmas einai hōde kai poiēsōmen treis skēnas mian soi kai mian Mōusei kai mian Ēlia
verses.literal: - - Peter vvv said - to Jesus Rabbi it is good for us to be here - Let us put up three shelters one for You - one for Moses and one for Elijah

verses.original: γὰρ ἐγένοντο ἔκφοβοι γὰρ οὐ ᾔδει τί ἀποκριθῇ
verses.transliteration: gar egenonto ekphoboi gar ou ēdei ti apokrithē
verses.literal: For they were all so terrified that vvv [Peter] did not know what else to say

verses.original: Καὶ νεφέλη ἐγένετο ἐπισκιάζουσα αὐτοῖς καὶ φωνὴ ἐγένετο ἐκ τῆς νεφέλης Οὗτός ἐστιν μου ὁ ἀγαπητός ὁ Υἱός ἀκούετε αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai nephelē egeneto episkiazousa autois kai phōnē egeneto ek tēs nephelēs Houtos estin mou ho agapētos ho Huios akouete autou
verses.literal: Then a cloud appeared [and] enveloped them and a voice came from the cloud This is My - beloved - Son Listen to Him

verses.original: καὶ ἐξάπινα περιβλεψάμενοι εἶδον οὐκέτι οὐδένα μεθ’ ἑαυτῶν ἀλλὰ μόνον τὸν Ἰησοῦν
verses.transliteration: kai exapina periblepsamenoi eidon ouketi oudena meth’ heautōn alla monon ton Iēsoun
verses.literal: - Suddenly [when] they looked around they saw no one with them except . . . - Jesus

verses.original: Καὶ αὐτῶν καταβαινόντων ἐκ τοῦ ὄρους διεστείλατο αὐτοῖς ἵνα διηγήσωνται μηδενὶ ἃ εἶδον εἰ μὴ ὅταν ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἀναστῇ ἐκ νεκρῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai autōn katabainontōn ek tou orous diesteilato autois hina diēgēsōntai mēdeni ha eidon ei mē hotan ho Huios tou anthrōpou anastē ek nekrōn
verses.literal: [As] they were coming down . . . the mountain [Jesus] admonished them - not to tell anyone . . . what they had seen vvv vvv until the Son - of Man had risen from [the] dead

verses.original: καὶ ἐκράτησαν τὸν λόγον πρὸς ἑαυτοὺς συζητοῦντες τί ἐστιν τὸ ἀναστῆναι ἐκ νεκρῶν
verses.transliteration: kai ekratēsan ton logon pros heautous syzētountes ti estin to anastēnai ek nekrōn
verses.literal: [So] they kept this matter to themselves discussing what it meant - to rise from [the] dead

verses.original: καὶ ἐπηρώτων αὐτὸν λέγοντες Ὅτι οἱ γραμματεῖς Λέγουσιν ὅτι Ἠλίαν δεῖ ἐλθεῖν πρῶτον
verses.transliteration: kai epērōtōn auton legontes Hoti hoi grammateis Legousin hoti Ēlian dei elthein prōton
verses.literal: And they asked [Jesus] - - {Why do} the scribes say that Elijah must come first

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ ἔφη αὐτοῖς Ἠλίας μὲν ἐλθὼν πρῶτον ἀποκαθιστάνει πάντα πῶς καὶ γέγραπται ἵνα ἐπὶ τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου πάθῃ πολλὰ καὶ ἐξουδενηθῇ
verses.transliteration: de Ho ephē autois Ēlias men elthōn prōton apokathistanei panta pōs kai gegraptai hina epi ton Huion tou anthrōpou pathē polla kai exoudenēthē
verses.literal: - - He replied . . . Elijah {does} indeed come first [and] he restores all things Why then is it written that - the Son - of Man must suffer many things and be rejected

verses.original: ἀλλὰ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι Ἠλίας καὶ ἐλήλυθεν καὶ ἐποίησαν αὐτῷ ὅσα ἤθελον καθὼς γέγραπται ἐπ’ αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: alla legō hymin hoti Ēlias kai elēlythen kai epoiēsan autō hosa ēthelon kathōs gegraptai ep’ auton
verses.literal: But I tell you that Elijah vvv has indeed come and they have done to him whatever they wished just as it is written about him

verses.original: Καὶ ἐλθόντες πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς εἶδον πολὺν ὄχλον περὶ αὐτοὺς καὶ γραμματεῖς συζητοῦντας πρὸς αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: Kai elthontes pros tous mathētas eidon polyn ochlon peri autous kai grammateis syzētountas pros autous
verses.literal: [When] they returned to the [other] disciples they saw a large crowd around them and scribes arguing with them

verses.original: καὶ εὐθὺς πᾶς ὁ ὄχλος ἰδόντες αὐτὸν ἐξεθαμβήθησαν καὶ προστρέχοντες ἠσπάζοντο αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai euthys pas ho ochlos idontes auton exethambēthēsan kai prostrechontes ēspazonto auton
verses.literal: - As soon as all the people saw [Jesus] they were filled with awe and ran to greet Him

verses.original: Τί συζητεῖτε πρὸς αὑτούς Καὶ ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: Ti syzēteite pros hautous Kai epērōtēsen autous
verses.literal: What are you disputing with them - He asked -

verses.original: Καὶ εἷς ἐκ τοῦ ὄχλου ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ Διδάσκαλε ἤνεγκα πρὸς σέ μου τὸν υἱόν ἔχοντα πνεῦμα ἄλαλον
verses.transliteration: Kai heis ek tou ochlou apekrithē autō Didaskale ēnenka pros se mou ton huion echonta pneuma alalon
verses.literal: - Someone in the crowd replied - Teacher I brought . . . You my - son who has a spirit [that makes him] mute

verses.original: καὶ ὅπου ἐὰν καταλάβῃ αὐτὸν ῥήσσει αὐτόν καὶ ἀφρίζει καὶ τρίζει τοὺς ὀδόντας καὶ ξηραίνεται καὶ εἶπα σου τοῖς μαθηταῖς ἵνα ἐκβάλωσιν αὐτὸ καὶ οὐκ ἴσχυσαν
verses.transliteration: kai hopou ean katalabē auton rhēssei auton kai aphrizei kai trizei tous odontas kai xērainetai kai eipa sou tois mathētais hina ekbalōsin auto kai ouk ischysan
verses.literal: - Whenever . . . it seizes him it throws him to the ground . . . - He foams at the mouth - gnashes - his teeth and becomes rigid - I asked Your - disciples to drive it out . . . but vvv they were unable

verses.original: Ὦ ἄπιστος γενεὰ δὲ αὐτοῖς λέγει Ὁ ἀποκριθεὶς ἕως πότε ἔσομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἕως πότε ἀνέξομαι ὑμῶν φέρετε αὐτὸν πρός με
verses.transliteration: Ō apistos genea de autois legei Ho apokritheis heōs pote esomai pros hymas heōs pote anexomai hymōn pherete auton pros me
verses.literal: O unbelieving generation - - [Jesus] - replied How long . . . must I remain with you How long . . . must I put up with you Bring [the boy] to Me

verses.original: Καὶ ἤνεγκαν αὐτὸν πρὸς αὐτόν καὶ ἰδὼν αὐτὸν τὸ πνεῦμα εὐθὺς συνεσπάραξεν αὐτόν καὶ πεσὼν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἐκυλίετο ἀφρίζων
verses.transliteration: Kai ēnenkan auton pros auton kai idōn auton to pneuma euthys synesparaxen auton kai pesōn epi tēs gēs ekylieto aphrizōn
verses.literal: So they brought him - - and seeing [Jesus] the spirit immediately threw [the boy] into a convulsion . . . - He fell to the ground [and] rolled around foaming at the mouth

verses.original: Καὶ ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτοῦ τὸν πατέρα Πόσος χρόνος ἐστὶν ὡς τοῦτο γέγονεν αὐτῷ Ἐκ παιδιόθεν δὲ Ὁ εἶπεν
verses.transliteration: Kai epērōtēsen autou ton patera Posos chronos estin hōs touto gegonen autō Ek paidiothen de Ho eipen
verses.literal: - [Jesus] asked [the boy’s] - father How long . . . . . . . . . {has} this been with him From childhood - - he said

verses.original: καὶ πολλάκις ἔβαλεν αὐτὸν καὶ εἰς πῦρ καὶ εἰς ὕδατα ἵνα ἀπολέσῃ αὐτόν ἀλλ’ εἴ δύνῃ τι σπλαγχνισθεὶς ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς βοήθησον ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: kai pollakis ebalen auton kai eis pyr kai eis hydata hina apolesē auton all’ ei dynē ti splanchnistheis eph’ hēmas boēthēson hēmin
verses.literal: - vvv It often throws him - into [the] fire [or] into [the] water trying to kill him But if You can [do] anything have compassion on us [and] help us

verses.original: Εἰ Τὸ δύνῃ δὲ Ὁ εἶπεν Ἰησοῦς αὐτῷ πάντα δυνατὰ τῷ πιστεύοντι
verses.transliteration: Ei To dynē de Ho eipen Iēsous autō panta dynata tō pisteuonti
verses.literal: If - You can - - echoed Jesus - All things are possible to him who believes

verses.original: Εὐθὺς ὁ τοῦ παιδίου πατὴρ κράξας ἔλεγεν Πιστεύω βοήθει μου τῇ ἀπιστίᾳ
verses.transliteration: Euthys ho tou paidiou patēr kraxas elegen Pisteuō boēthei mou tē apistia
verses.literal: Immediately the vvv boy’s father cried out - I do believe help my - unbelief

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἰδὼν ὅτι ὄχλος ἐπισυντρέχει ἐπετίμησεν τῷ τῷ ἀκαθάρτῳ πνεύματι κωφὸν καὶ Τὸ ἄλαλον πνεῦμα λέγων αὐτῷ ἐγὼ ἐπιτάσσω σοι ἔξελθε ἐξ αὐτοῦ καὶ μηκέτι εἰσέλθῃς εἰς αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: de ho Iēsous Idōn hoti ochlos episyntrechei epetimēsen tō tō akathartō pneumati kōphon kai To alalon pneuma legōn autō egō epitassō soi exelthe ex autou kai mēketi eiselthēs eis auton
verses.literal: When - Jesus saw that a crowd had come running He rebuked the - unclean spirit [You] deaf and - mute spirit He said - I command you to come out - and never enter . . . him {again}

verses.original: κράξας καὶ σπαράξας πολλὰ Καὶ ἐξῆλθεν καὶ ἐγένετο ὡσεὶ νεκρὸς ὥστε τοὺς πολλοὺς λέγειν ὅτι ἀπέθανεν
verses.transliteration: kraxas kai sparaxas polla Kai exēlthen kai egeneto hōsei nekros hōste tous pollous legein hoti apethanen
verses.literal: After shrieking and convulsing him violently . . . - [the spirit] came out - [The boy] became like a corpse so that - many said - He is dead

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς κρατήσας αὐτοῦ τῆς χειρὸς ἤγειρεν αὐτόν καὶ ἀνέστη
verses.transliteration: de ho Iēsous kratēsas autou tēs cheiros ēgeiren auton kai anestē
verses.literal: But - Jesus took him by the hand [and] helped him to his feet . . . and he stood up

verses.original: Καὶ αὐτοῦ εἰσελθόντος εἰς οἶκον αὐτοῦ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἐπηρώτων αὐτόν κατ’ ἰδίαν Ὅτι ἠδυνήθημεν οὐκ ἡμεῖς ἐκβαλεῖν αὐτό
verses.transliteration: Kai autou eiselthontos eis oikon autou hoi mathētai epērōtōn auton kat’ idian Hoti ēdynēthēmen ouk hēmeis ekbalein auto
verses.literal: After [Jesus] had gone into [the] house His - disciples asked Him vvv privately Why couldn’t . . . we drive it out . . .

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Τοῦτο τὸ γένος δύναται ἐν οὐδενὶ ἐξελθεῖν εἰ μὴ ἐν προσευχῇ
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen autois Touto to genos dynatai en oudeni exelthein ei mē en proseuchē
verses.literal: - [Jesus] answered - This - kind cannot . . . . . . come out except . . . by prayer

verses.original: ἐξελθόντες Κἀκεῖθεν παρεπορεύοντο διὰ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ οὐκ ἤθελεν ἵνα τις γνοῖ
verses.transliteration: exelthontes Kakeithen pareporeuonto dia tēs Galilaias kai ouk ēthelen hina tis gnoi
verses.literal: Going on from there they passed through - Galilee But vvv [Jesus] did not want - anyone to know

verses.original: γὰρ ἐδίδασκεν αὐτοῦ τοὺς μαθητὰς καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς ὅτι Ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδίδοται εἰς χεῖρας ἀνθρώπων καὶ ἀποκτενοῦσιν αὐτόν καὶ ἀποκτανθεὶς μετὰ τρεῖς ἡμέρας ἀναστήσεται
verses.transliteration: gar edidasken autou tous mathētas kai elegen autois hoti Ho Huios tou anthrōpou paradidotai eis cheiras anthrōpōn kai apoktenousin auton kai apoktantheis meta treis hēmeras anastēsetai
verses.literal: because He was teaching His - disciples - He told them - The Son - of Man will be delivered into [the] hands of men - They will kill Him and - after three days He will rise

verses.original: δὲ οἱ ἠγνόουν τὸ ῥῆμα καὶ ἐφοβοῦντο ἐπερωτῆσαι αὐτὸν
verses.transliteration: de hoi ēgnooun to rhēma kai ephobounto eperōtēsai auton
verses.literal: But - they did not understand this statement and they were afraid to ask Him [about it]

verses.original: Καὶ ἦλθον εἰς Καφαρναούμ Καὶ γενόμενος ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ ἐπηρώτα αὐτούς Τί διελογίζεσθε ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ
verses.transliteration: Kai ēlthon eis Kapharnaoum Kai genomenos en tē oikia epērōta autous Ti dielogizesthe en tē hodō
verses.literal: Then they came to Capernaum - While [Jesus] was in the house He asked them What were you discussing on the way

verses.original: δὲ οἱ ἐσιώπων γὰρ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ διελέχθησαν πρὸς ἀλλήλους τίς μείζων
verses.transliteration: de hoi esiōpōn gar en tē hodō dielechthēsan pros allēlous tis meizōn
verses.literal: But - they were silent for on the way they had been arguing about . . . . . . which [of them was] [the] greatest

verses.original: Καὶ καθίσας ἐφώνησεν τοὺς δώδεκα καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Εἴ τις θέλει εἶναι πρῶτος ἔσται ἔσχατος πάντων καὶ διάκονος πάντων
verses.transliteration: Kai kathisas ephōnēsen tous dōdeka kai legei autois Ei tis thelei einai prōtos estai eschatos pantōn kai diakonos pantōn
verses.literal: - Sitting down [Jesus] called the Twelve and said - If anyone wants to be first he must be [the] last of all and [the] servant of all

verses.original: Καὶ λαβὼν ἔστησεν παιδίον αὐτὸ ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν καὶ ἐναγκαλισάμενος αὐτὸ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: Kai labōn estēsen paidion auto en mesō autōn kai enankalisamenos auto eipen autois
verses.literal: Then vvv He had a little child {stand} - vvv among them - Taking [the child] in His arms . . . He said to them

verses.original: Ὃς ἂν δέξηται ἓν τῶν τοιούτων παιδίων ἐπὶ μου τῷ ὀνόματί δέχεται ἐμὲ καὶ ὃς ἂν δέχηται ἐμὲ δέχεται οὐκ ἐμὲ ἀλλὰ τὸν ἀποστείλαντά με
verses.transliteration: Hos an dexētai hen tōn toioutōn paidiōn epi mou tō onomati dechetai eme kai hos an dechētai eme dechetai ouk eme alla ton aposteilanta me
verses.literal: Whoever . . . welcomes one - of these little children in My - name welcomes Me and whoever . . . welcomes Me welcomes not only Me but the [One] who sent Me

verses.original: ὁ Ἰωάννης Ἔφη αὐτῷ Διδάσκαλε εἴδομέν τινα ὃς οὐκ ἀκολουθεῖ ἡμῖν ἐκβάλλοντα δαιμόνια ἐν σου τῷ ὀνόματί καὶ ἐκωλύομεν αὐτόν ὅτι οὐκ ἠκολούθει ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: ho Iōannēs Ephē autō Didaskale eidomen tina hos ouk akolouthei hēmin ekballonta daimonia en sou tō onomati kai ekōlyomen auton hoti ouk ēkolouthei hēmin
verses.literal: - John said to Him Teacher we saw someone else . . . . . . . . . driving out demons in Your - name and we tried to stop him because . . . he does not accompany us

verses.original: Μὴ κωλύετε αὐτόν δὲ Ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν γάρ ἐστιν οὐδεὶς ὃς ποιήσει δύναμιν ἐπὶ μου τῷ ὀνόματί δυνήσεται ταχὺ καὶ κακολογῆσαί με
verses.transliteration: Mē kōlyete auton de Ho Iēsous eipen gar estin oudeis hos poiēsei dynamin epi mou tō onomati dynēsetai tachy kai kakologēsai me
verses.literal: {Do} not stop him - - Jesus replied For - no one who performs a miracle in My - name can turn around and speak evil of Me

verses.original: γὰρ ὃς ἔστιν οὐκ καθ’ ἡμῶν ἐστιν ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: gar hos estin ouk kath’ hēmōn estin hyper hēmōn
verses.literal: For whoever is not against us is for us

verses.original: γὰρ Ὃς ἂν ποτίσῃ ὑμᾶς ποτήριον ὕδατος ὅτι ἐστε ἐν ὀνόματι Χριστοῦ ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐ μὴ ἀπολέσῃ αὐτοῦ τὸν μισθὸν
verses.transliteration: gar Hos an potisē hymas potērion hydatos hoti este en onomati Christou amēn legō hymin hoti ou mē apolesē autou ton misthon
verses.literal: Indeed if anyone . . . gives you [even] a cup of water because you bear . . . the name of Christ truly I tell you - vvv vvv he will never lose his - reward

verses.original: Καὶ ὃς ἂν σκανδαλίσῃ ἕνα τούτων τῶν μικρῶν τῶν πιστευόντων εἰς ἐμέ ἐστιν καλόν αὐτῷ εἰ μᾶλλον ὀνικὸς μύλος περίκειται περὶ αὐτοῦ τὸν τράχηλον καὶ βέβληται εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν
verses.transliteration: Kai hos an skandalisē hena toutōn tōn mikrōn tōn pisteuontōn eis eme estin kalon autō ei mallon onikos mylos perikeitai peri autou ton trachēlon kai beblētai eis tēn thalassan
verses.literal: But if anyone . . . causes one of these - little ones who believe in Me {to stumble} it would be better for him to have . . . a large millstone hung around his - neck and to be thrown into the sea

verses.original: Καὶ ἐὰν σου ἡ χείρ σκανδαλίζῃ σε ἀπόκοψον αὐτήν ἐστίν καλόν σε εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν ζωὴν κυλλὸν ἢ ἔχοντα δύο τὰς χεῖρας ἀπελθεῖν εἰς τὴν γέενναν εἰς τὸ τὸ ἄσβεστον πῦρ
verses.transliteration: Kai ean sou hē cheir skandalizē se apokopson autēn estin kalon se eiselthein eis tēn zōēn kyllon ē echonta dyo tas cheiras apelthein eis tēn geennan eis to to asbeston pyr
verses.literal: - If your - hand causes you to sin . . . cut it off . . . It is better for you to enter . . . - life crippled than to have two - hands [and] go into - hell into the - unquenchable fire

verses.original: καὶ ἐὰν σου ὁ πούς σκανδαλίζῃ σε ἀπόκοψον αὐτόν ἐστίν καλόν σε εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν ζωὴν χωλὸν ἢ ἔχοντα τοὺς δύο πόδας βληθῆναι εἰς τὴν γέενναν
verses.transliteration: kai ean sou ho pous skandalizē se apokopson auton estin kalon se eiselthein eis tēn zōēn chōlon ē echonta tous dyo podas blēthēnai eis tēn geennan
verses.literal: - If your - foot causes you to sin . . . cut it off . . . It is better for you to enter . . . - life lame than to have - two feet [and] be thrown into - hell

verses.original: καὶ ἐὰν σου ὁ ὀφθαλμός σκανδαλίζῃ σε ἔκβαλε αὐτόν ἐστιν καλόν σέ εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ μονόφθαλμον ἢ ἔχοντα δύο ὀφθαλμοὺς βληθῆναι εἰς τὴν γέενναν
verses.transliteration: kai ean sou ho ophthalmos skandalizē se ekbale auton estin kalon se eiselthein eis tēn basileian tou Theou monophthalmon ē echonta dyo ophthalmous blēthēnai eis tēn geennan
verses.literal: And if your - eye causes you to sin . . . pluck it out . . . It is better for you to enter . . . the kingdom - of God with one eye than to have two eyes [and] be thrown into - hell

verses.original: ὅπου αὐτῶν Ὁ σκώληξ οὐ τελευτᾷ καὶ τὸ πῦρ οὐ σβέννυται
verses.transliteration: hopou autōn Ho skōlēx ou teleuta kai to pyr ou sbennytai
verses.literal: where their - worm never dies and the fire vvv is never quenched

verses.original: γὰρ Πᾶς ἁλισθήσεται πυρὶ
verses.transliteration: gar Pas halisthēsetai pyri
verses.literal: For everyone will be salted with fire

verses.original: τὸ ἅλας καλὸν δὲ ἐὰν τὸ ἅλας γένηται ἄναλον ἐν τίνι ἀρτύσετε αὐτὸ ἔχετε ἅλα ἐν ἑαυτοῖς καὶ εἰρηνεύετε ἐν ἀλλήλοις
verses.transliteration: to halas kalon de ean to halas genētai analon en tini artysete auto echete hala en heautois kai eirēneuete en allēlois
verses.literal: - Salt [is] good but if the salt loses its saltiness with what will you season it Have salt among yourselves and be at peace with one another
